subject: CHEMISTRY
question: 2.24 dm³ of CO₂ was collected at 27°C and 750 mmHg. Find the volume it will occupy at 100°C and 600 mmHg.
keyPoint: Use absolute temperature and the combined gas law when pressure, volume, and temperature change.
examTip: Convert Celsius to Kelvin before substitution.
commonMistake: Using Celsius directly in a gas-law calculation.
